notes: CHK-001 and CHK-004 are checked from i_clk_rd edges, so the "same time step as the reset assertion" part is only checked while i_rst_n_rd is still low at an edge. It is not checked at the reset edge itself. CHK-004 detects off-edge changes with an event-driven helper that compares $time against the last i_clk_rd edge, the last i_rst_n_rd change and the last i_empty_thr change. Changes at time 0 are ignored. CHK-002 samples i_rst_n_wr, i_rst_n_sw and o_sw_rst_busy as levels with $past on i_clk_rd, as the check text requires. I did not compile or simulate this code.
